_meta.purpose: Static hints for Structure tool-config UI and Stack32 Builder when wiring Pipedream apps. Not exhaustive — learning playbooks override when present. User-facing UI must NOT display summary/builder_guidance text.

notion.summary: Notion Connect actions usually operate on an existing page/database — creation of arbitrary pages is limited; prefer update/append/comment on a configured page.

required_static_hints.label: Page Notion
required_static_hints.why: La page que l’agent doit lire ou mettre à jour.

required_static_hints.label: Base Notion
required_static_hints.why: La base (tableau) Notion concernée.

notion.builder_guidance: When adding Notion tools, ask the user to pick a page or database in Structure after Connect. Do not assume blank-workspace page creation works for every action.

slack.summary: Messaging requires a channel (or user) destination in addition to account connection.

required_static_hints.label: Canal Slack
required_static_hints.why: Le canal où l’agent peut écrire ou lire.

slack.builder_guidance: After Slack Connect, prompt for default channel in tool config. Prefer remoteOptions for channel pickers.

slack_v2.summary: Slack v2 app slug — same channel requirements as slack.

required_static_hints.label: Canal Slack
required_static_hints.why: Le canal où l’agent peut écrire ou lire.

slack_v2.builder_guidance: Treat like slack; bind channel in tool_config.

discord.summary: Bot posts need a guild channel; invite the bot with correct permissions.

required_static_hints.label: Canal Discord
required_static_hints.why: Le salon où le bot peut écrire.

discord.builder_guidance: Surface channel picker after Connect; warn about missing bot permissions.

google_calendar.summary: Create-event expects eventStartDate/eventEndDate strings (or quick-add text), not Google API start/end objects, when using Pipedream actions.

required_static_hints.label: Agenda
required_static_hints.why: Quel calendrier Google l’agent doit utiliser (souvent « principal »).

google_calendar.builder_guidance: Prefer native calendar_* tools with Pipedream OAuth fallback. Never use slug google_calendar as the auth prop key.

gmail.summary: Send/draft need recipients; list/search need query scope awareness.
gmail.builder_guidance: When the user connects Gmail via Pipedream, bind send/list/draft actions as needed. OAuth is the authorization — execute send/post when the user asks.

canva.summary: canva-create-design uses reloadProps: designType preset|custom then dynamic name/width/height. Must reload props and pass dynamic_props_id.

required_static_hints.label: Type de design
required_static_hints.why: Modèle prêt à l’emploi, ou taille personnalisée.

required_static_hints.label: Modèle Canva
required_static_hints.why: Quel format (document, présentation, e-mail…).

canva.builder_guidance: Default designType=preset and name=doc if the model omits them; always reload dynamic props before run.

stripe.summary: Many Stripe actions are account-scoped; Connect accounts / Stripe Connect platforms may need account or customer ids.

required_static_hints.label: Client ou compte Stripe
required_static_hints.why: Le client ou le compte Connect concerné par l’opération.

stripe.builder_guidance: After Stripe Connect, inspect the action schema for customer/account props and mark them static when the agent always uses one account.

hubspot.summary: CRM writes need object type + properties; association ids often required.

required_static_hints.label: Boîte de réception
required_static_hints.why: Quelle boîte HubSpot (inbox) l’agent doit utiliser pour les messages.

required_static_hints.label: Canal
required_static_hints.why: Le canal de messagerie HubSpot concerné.

required_static_hints.label: Fil de discussion
required_static_hints.why: La conversation précise dans la boîte (si l’agent doit répondre à un fil).

hubspot.builder_guidance: Prefer remoteOptions for owners/pipelines; keep property maps in tool_config when stable. Ask which inbox/channel the agent should use.

airtable.summary: Base + table (+ optional view) are almost always required before row ops.

required_static_hints.label: Base Airtable
required_static_hints.why: L’espace Airtable (base) où lire ou écrire.

required_static_hints.label: Table
required_static_hints.why: La table (feuille) dans cette base.

airtable.builder_guidance: Chain remoteOptions: base → table → fields. Treat as reloadProps-heavy.

google_sheets.summary: Classic dynamic-props example: spreadsheet then worksheet then headers/columns; requires dynamic_props_id.

required_static_hints.label: Drive
required_static_hints.why: Mon Drive, ou un Drive partagé de l’équipe.

required_static_hints.label: Fichier Google Sheets
required_static_hints.why: Le classeur (fichier) que l’agent doit utiliser.

required_static_hints.label: Feuille
required_static_hints.why: L’onglet à l’intérieur du fichier (ex. Feuille 1).

required_static_hints.label: La première ligne contient des titres
required_static_hints.why: Oui si la ligne du haut nomme les colonnes.

required_static_hints.label: Ligne des titres
required_static_hints.why: Numéro de la ligne qui contient les noms de colonnes (souvent 1).

required_static_hints.label: Surveiller tout le Drive
required_static_hints.why: Oui = réagir aux changements dans le Drive entier.

google_sheets.builder_guidance: Always reload props after sheetId; never drop dynamic_props_id. Prefer a specific spreadsheet + worksheet for the agent goal.

google_docs.summary: Create/append usually need a document id after creation; prefer native google_docs_* tools.

required_static_hints.label: Document
required_static_hints.why: Append/update ops need an existing doc.

google_docs.builder_guidance: Prefer native google_docs_create/append; auth prop camelCase if using Pipedream actions.

google_drive.summary: File ops need folder/file ids; downloads may require stash_id.

required_static_hints.label: Folder / file
required_static_hints.why: Drive actions need a target folder or file.

google_drive.builder_guidance: Use stash_id when downloading files to /tmp for File Stash.

github.summary: Issues/PRs need owner + repo; often remoteOptions.

required_static_hints.label: Repository
required_static_hints.why: Almost all GitHub actions are repo-scoped.

github.builder_guidance: Bind default owner/repo in tool_config for agent-scoped repos.

gitlab.summary: Project ID is usually required; self-hosted needs base URL custom field.

required_static_hints.label: Project
required_static_hints.why: GitLab actions are project-scoped.

gitlab.builder_guidance: Use remoteOptions for projectId; relative proxy paths for self-hosted.

linear.summary: Issues need team id; optional project/state.

required_static_hints.label: Team
required_static_hints.why: Linear issues belong to a team.

jira.summary: Issues need cloud project key / id.

required_static_hints.label: Project
required_static_hints.why: Jira create/update is project-scoped.

jira.builder_guidance: Bind project key in static config.

required_static_hints.label: Workspace / project
required_static_hints.why: Asana tasks live under a project.

required_static_hints.label: Board / list
required_static_hints.why: Cards are created in a list on a board.

clickup.summary: Tasks need list id in a space/folder hierarchy.

required_static_hints.label: List
required_static_hints.why: ClickUp tasks belong to a list.

required_static_hints.label: Board
required_static_hints.why: Monday items are board-scoped.

zendesk.summary: Tickets for a subdomain account; use relative proxy paths.
zendesk.builder_guidance: Dynamic domain — prefer relative API paths via Connect proxy.

intercom.builder_guidance: Prefer drafts over auto-send for replies.

freshdesk.summary: Tickets for a domain; may need group/agent ids.
freshdesk.builder_guidance: Inspect schema for group_id after Connect.

salesforce.summary: Objects need type + field maps; sandbox vs prod accounts.
salesforce.builder_guidance: Keep object field maps in tool_config when stable.

shopify.builder_guidance: Premium app — confirm Connect plan; bind shop context.

woocommerce.summary: Store URL + keys via Connect; product/order ids for writes.
woocommerce.builder_guidance: Confirm store connection health before Live.

required_static_hints.label: Audience
required_static_hints.why: Mailchimp ops are list-scoped.

klaviyo.summary: Lists/flows need list or flow ids.

required_static_hints.label: List / flow
required_static_hints.why: Klaviyo actions target lists or flows.

sendgrid.summary: From address / template ids often required.

required_static_hints.label: From / template
required_static_hints.why: Transactional send needs verified sender.

sendgrid.builder_guidance: Prefer templates; keep from-address in static config.

twitter.summary: Posting needs text; media may need upload + stash.
twitter.builder_guidance: Bind create-tweet / post actions when the user wants to publish. OAuth authorizes posting.

linkedin.summary: Org vs personal author urn may be required.

required_static_hints.label: Author
required_static_hints.why: Posts need an author URN.

linkedin.builder_guidance: Bind share/post actions after Connect; use the author URN from connection metadata when required.

instagram.summary: Publishing needs media container + IG business account.
instagram.builder_guidance: Caption-only agents may not need publish tools.

youtube.builder_guidance: Script drafting may not need upload scopes.

facebook.summary: Page id often required for posts.

required_static_hints.label: Page
required_static_hints.why: Page posts need a Page id.

required_static_hints.label: File
required_static_hints.why: Figma APIs are file-scoped.

dropbox.summary: Path required for upload/download; stash for cross-action files.

required_static_hints.label: Path
required_static_hints.why: Dropbox ops need a folder/file path.

required_static_hints.label: Folder / file
required_static_hints.why: Box items are id-scoped.

required_static_hints.label: Item / path
required_static_hints.why: OneDrive ops need a target item.

microsoft_onedrive.builder_guidance: Auth prop name from component definition.

microsoft_teams.summary: Team + channel ids required for posts.

required_static_hints.label: Team / channel
required_static_hints.why: Teams messages are channel-scoped.

required_static_hints.label: Workbook / sheet
required_static_hints.why: Excel actions are workbook-scoped.

twilio.summary: From/to phone numbers required for SMS.

required_static_hints.label: From / to
required_static_hints.why: SMS needs E.164 numbers.

twilio.builder_guidance: Bind verified from-number in static config.

telegram.summary: Chat id required for bot messages.

required_static_hints.label: Chat
required_static_hints.why: Bot messages need a chat id.

required_static_hints.label: Recipient / template
required_static_hints.why: WhatsApp Business sends need recipient + often a template.

whatsapp.builder_guidance: Prefer approved templates; bind phone number id.

zoom.summary: Meetings need topic/time; user id sometimes required.
zoom.builder_guidance: Admin Zoom may be premium; check account type.

supabase.summary: Project URL + table for row ops.

required_static_hints.label: Table
required_static_hints.why: Row ops need a table name.

supabase.builder_guidance: Prefer read-only queries for agents unless approved.

postgresql.summary: SQL prop type with prepared statements; schema via configure.
postgresql.builder_guidance: Use sql prop + params; never interpolate user input into SQL.

required_static_hints.label: DB / collection
required_static_hints.why: Mongo ops are collection-scoped.

snowflake.builder_guidance: Premium app; use prepared SQL patterns.

aws.summary: S3 bucket + key for object ops; region awareness.

required_static_hints.label: Bucket / key
required_static_hints.why: S3 ops need bucket and object key.

close.summary: CRM leads/opportunities; often needs lead/opportunity ids.
close.builder_guidance: Inspect schema after Connect for lead/opportunity props.

pagerduty.summary: Incidents need service id; escalation policies optional.

required_static_hints.label: Service
required_static_hints.why: Incidents are service-scoped.

pagerduty.builder_guidance: Bind default service for on-call agents.
